tests.test: the runtime is built with a real JavaScript engine
a test VSIX package was written
the extension installed from the VSIX package
the installed extension appears in the shared registry
the registry is persisted so the IDE sees the same state
the VS Code extension API initialises
the extension loads into the JavaScript host
the extension activates and its JavaScript runs
the engine evaluates JavaScript in the extension context and returns 42
the command registered by the extension executes
an unknown command is refused rather than crashing
activating an unknown extension is refused
a JavaScript exception is reported rather than crashing the host
the uninstalled extension left the shared registry
the JavaScript extension host shuts down cleanly
